title: Oke Okka Korika – Kenny Chaitanya Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: శ్రమలనే కొలిమి నుండి నన్ను పైకి లాగవా
నీ కొరకై సిద్ధము చేసిన బలము కోసమే
english: Shramalane kolimi nundi nannu paiki laagavaa
Nee korakai siddhamu chesina balamu kosame
translation: Oke Okka Korika – English Translation
This song is a heartfelt plea for God’s mercy, expressing the exhaustion of a soul waiting for a breakthrough amidst long-standing trials.
Chorus
Forgive me and grant this just one request, O Jesus;
I have grown weary of asking time and time again.
I have come into Your presence; please do not cast me away;
I have been waiting for You for so many years.
Won’t You show me kindness at least this time?
Won’t You show me Your mercy at least this time?
Verse 1
I have been crushed at the hands of my adversaries;
I have been scorched in the furnace of afflictions.
I am not made of silver to endure this heat;
I am but a man of clay to bear such trials.
It is enough now, Lord;
Please pull me up from this furnace of suffering.
Verse 2
As I sow my seeds while shedding tears,
I hope to reap the harvest with songs of joy.
For the strength and fruit You have prepared for me,
I shall wait and seek You in fasting and prayer.
It is enough now, Lord;
Please pull me up from this valley of tears.
intro: Oke Okka Korika is the latest Telugu Christian song, written & tuned by Shadrak, sung by Palivela Anand and music composed by Kenny Chaitanya, produced by Krupasana ministries. This song was released on March 26, 2026, through Krupasana Ministries YouTube Channel.
